value.rationale: The motivating paper highlights the open comparison and order problem of generalized Medvedev logics but proves strictness only at widths in a factor-four-spaced sequence. The exact fan-quotient capacity is a natural invariant of its own chosen generator family, removes the exponential gaps and produces explicit Jankov separators for every consecutive pair. This is an all-size exact classification within a structurally motivated subfamily rather than a routine parameter substitution or isolated finite enumeration.
